summary: Lens: a table level of an explorer returns and draws its footer total (QueryResponse.Summary, runtime.PanelResult.TableTotals / ApplyTableTotals); screen-reader labels (period steps, quality chips, export errors) are translated in the built-in ru and uz catalogues, and the SDK's English baseline no longer hides built-in translations for those locales (document.RuntimeI18nDefaultsFor); tables narrow and wrap to their container before they scroll.
